# Release Freeze Windows

Periods in which nothing but fixes ships: the last two working days of a customer's month-end, the week of a customer's own launch, and any day I am travelling. Exceptions need a reason written in the deploy channel. Announce a window one week ahead. See [[webhook-relay]] for how deploys roll.
